examples.personaHint: Try questions customers like you often ask:

dealer.label: Overseas parts dealer
dealer.p1: I need EXW reference prices for a restock list: SINOTRUK filters and brake parts, about 200 pcs mixed. Can you check the catalogue?
dealer.p2: We mainly sell economy replacements to African workshops. How do you label OE vs economy quality on quotes?
dealer.p3: Please help me turn several part numbers into an EXW reference line list before our sales confirms MOQ.

mine.label: Mine / off-highway site
mine.p1: Our mining trucks need wear parts urgently. I don’t have part numbers—what photos or nameplate info should I send?
mine.p2: Looking for SINOTRUK / HOWO dump-truck consumables for a mine site. Can you look up catalogue EXW references in CNY and USD?
mine.p3: Lead time matters more than the lowest price. After you find parts in the catalogue, how do we get sales to confirm availability?

fleet.label: Fleet operator
fleet.p1: We run a mixed HOWO and SHACMAN fleet. Need periodic service parts—filters, belts—with quantities for a recurring order.
fleet.p2: We prefer FOB to Lagos later, but first I need EXW China reference prices from your catalogue for a few part numbers.
fleet.p3: Same parts every quarter. Can you help structure an RFQ card: brands, qty, destination, and quality preference?

workshop.label: Repair shop / parts counter
workshop.p1: Customer is waiting in the bay. I have one urgent part number—please look it up and give CNY and USD EXW reference.
workshop.p2: The part number on the old piece is unclear. What should I ask the driver so you can search the catalogue correctly?
workshop.p3: Catalogue shows a related part. Can it replace the original, or must the customer confirm fitment first?

contractor.label: Project / construction buyer
contractor.p1: Project purchase: batch of heavy-truck chassis parts for site equipment. Need EXW references first, then packing notes.
contractor.p2: Do we need certificates or special export packing for our destination? I can share country/port if you tell me what you need.
contractor.p3: Please collect my requirements into a card, then tell me how to contact sales for a formal quotation—not just chat reference prices.
